answer: Admit earners by random-walk intersection, SybilLimit-style. Each epoch every verifier sends ~log n short walks across the payment-and-vouch graph; a newcomer is paid only if its own walks' tail edges meet the verifier's. Honest agents form dense, opal-bright cross-links, but a farm is karst: huge hollow caves joined to the surface by a few inlet edges to real agents. Walks rarely enter those caves, so accepted clones cap near log2(n) per attack edge. Assuming 10,000 agents (~13 per edge), 1,000 paid clones need ~75 inlet edges, each a real agent who trades with the farm and can be cut.
